- you are available to work 16 to 40 hours per week;
- you are able to work 1 weekend per month;
- you live near the Helmond area;
- you have your own transportation to reach the work location in Helmond.

What will you do
As a warehouse employee at Modexpress in Helmond, you are the backbone behind the newest clothing collections before they hit the stores! You start your shift packed with energy and dive into a dynamic day. One moment you are picking orders with a hand scanner, and the next moment you are unboxing, tagging, and preparing brand-new outfits for shipment. Every day will be different from the day before.   Shifts are from Monday till Friday in either 2 or 3 shifts. The working hours are between 08:00 and 23:00, there aren’t any night shifts. You can choose how many days you want to work a week and also which shift you want to work (2- or 3 shifts).
